events.text: January 2026: Carl Novak's lease L-CARL on GPU-003 opened with a 20% deposit (200‰ equity) at the locked price of £10,000 (§1.2).

promise.text: Carl promised to pay double rent in August in return for skipping July.

events.text: July 2026: Carl was granted a payment holiday (§4.2). Carl promised to pay double rent in August.
August 2026: Carl did not pay. His promise to pay double was broken. Equity repossessed under §4.3.
September 2026: Carl missed rent again. Equity repossessed under §4.3.
October 2026: Carl holds 4.0% equity (40‰) in GPU-003; rent is £480.00/month.
